projects.title: PPSTrigger
projects.tagline: Adjustable USB-C PD bench supply on a custom PCB
projects.summary: A pocket bench power supply. It negotiates a USB-C Power Delivery PPS or AVS contract with a charger, lets you dial in voltage and current limit from the board, and shows the live output voltage on a 7-segment display.
highlights: Two-layer KiCad board: ATmega328P, AP33772S USB-PD sink controller, TPS62933 buck regulator, MOSFET output switching, current-sense shunt and NTC thermistor
Register-level AVR firmware: Timer2 1 ms tick, pin-change interrupts with software debounce, multiplexed three-digit display
Requests 5–28 V in 0.1 V steps with a 0.5–3 A current limit, waits for button presses to settle before sending a new request over I²C, and falls back to a fixed PDO on chargers without PPS/AVS
Fabrication outputs checked in: Gerbers, drill files, BOM and paste stencil

projects.title: TixClock
projects.tagline: A miniature, battery-powered recreation of the ThinkGeek Tix clock
projects.summary: The Tix clock, sold by ThinkGeek in 2006 and long since discontinued, shows the time as shuffling patterns of lit squares. TixClock rebuilds it in miniature on a chip-down RP2040 board.
highlights: Chip-down RP2040 design with external QSPI flash and crystal, PCF8523 real-time clock with coin-cell backup, and a level shifter driving 27 WS2812B LEDs
18650 power path: TP4056 charger, DW01A/8205A protection and a TPS61022 boost converter, fed from USB-C
Firmware shuffles the lit LEDs in each colour-coded field every minute using the RP2040's random source; three buttons set the time
Next up: battery management and an enclosure

projects.title: StepperMusic
projects.tagline: MIDI files performed by stepper motors
projects.summary: Turns stepper motors into instruments. A Python host parses a MIDI file and streams notes over serial to an Arduino, which drives up to five motors at audio frequencies.
highlights: Python host (mido + pyserial) flattens every MIDI track into one timed note stream, reduces it to the available polyphony and assigns motors ahead of time to avoid runtime races
Non-blocking Arduino firmware for an Uno R4 WiFi and A4988 drivers generates step pulses on micros() timing, so notes on different motors can overlap
Plain-text serial protocol: motor, frequency, duration per line

projects.title: Design Hub Reservation Waterfall
projects.tagline: A live Gantt chart for a makerspace's 3D-printer reservations
projects.summary: A browser userscript for the Engineering Design Hub's reservation system at the University of Nebraska–Lincoln. It turns the day's reservation table into a waterfall chart, so staff can see every printer's schedule at a glance.
highlights: Parses the reservation table in place and draws a dark-mode timeline per printer, in a configurable order, with a current-time marker
Assigns tool colours on the fly, hides idle printers behind a toggle, and shows reservation details on hover
Published on Greasy Fork for one-click install
